source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free unbranded alto saxophone on one rising diagonal with one flared bell, bent neck and mouthpiece, exactly seven round key pads, three long key rods, one strap loop, two separate music-note symbols, two sound arcs, and one broken shadow.

process_strategy: Reserve the full bent tube, bell, neck, mouthpiece, seven pad centers, three rod routes, strap loop, two notes, two arcs, highlights, and shadow in pale construction; convert those same footprints into persistent contours; color-code the established pads and notes before the black outline; stop rods and pads at the body silhouette; and limit the final panel to outline, fill, highlight, and shadow cleanup.

final_elements.description: One diagonal alto-sax envelope with a flared bell, bent body and neck, mouthpiece, seven pad centers, three rod routes, strap loop, two music notes, two sound arcs, highlight gaps, and shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: flared bell curved saxophone body bent neck and mouthpiece contours
final_elements.description: One stable face-free alto-sax silhouette with a broad bell, J-curved body tube, raised neck, and dark mouthpiece.

final_elements.name: seven colored key pads three key rods strap loop two music notes two sound arcs and highlights
final_elements.description: Exactly seven round key pads color-coded teal and coral, three long rods, one small loop, two separate coral music-note symbols, two sound arcs, and three open-paper instrument highlights.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline key hatching and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces every established contour and adds short hatching to the already established key hardware and broken shadow.

final_elements.name: mustard ochre and deep-navy body mouthpiece and shadow fills
final_elements.description: Warm mustard and ochre brass plus a deep-navy mouthpiece and shadow, layered around the already colored keys, notes, and highlight gaps with visible marker grain.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free saxophone, one rising diagonal, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep one bell, one bent neck, one mouthpiece, seven key pads, three rods, one strap loop, two notes, two sound arcs, three highlights, and one shadow after those elements appear.
Key hardware must stop at the instrument body and body fills must stop at reserved pads and highlights; no taught line may be erased to fake the assembly.
Do not add a face, hands, musician, case, brand mark, words, letters, numbers, extra notes, sticker border, badge frame, label, arrow, signature, or watermark.
The final panel may not introduce a pad, rod, loop, note, arc, highlight, hatch cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean clip art, polished product rendering, or glossy AI poster art.
